description: List contacts, optionally filtered by email and status, with pagination.

email.description: Optional email to filter contacts by (case-insensitive exact match).

status.description: Optional status value to filter contacts by.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of contacts to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a list of contact objects and a meta block containing the total count; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single contact by its id.

contact_id.description: The unique id of the contact.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with the contact object; on failure (contact not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new contact with the given email and optional attributes.

email.description: The email address of the contact (required).

first_name.description: Optional first name of the contact.

last_name.description: Optional last name of the contact.

phone.description: Optional phone number of the contact.

status.description: Optional status value for the contact (default '1').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with the created contact object; on failure (missing email or duplicate), output contains an error message.

description: List all contact lists with pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of lists to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a list of list objects and a meta block containing the total count; on failure, output contains an error message.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of campaigns to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a list of campaign objects and a meta block containing the total count; on failure, output contains an error message.

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default 20).

offset.description: Number of deals to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a list of deal objects and a meta block containing the total count; on failure, output contains an error message.
